source_documents.title: Human Functional Registry v0.2 Corrected & Verified Edition

closed_scope: Fully enumerated Human Functional Registry v1.0 source extracted into deterministic machine-readable custody.
Effective Human-derived functional source count raised from 2,560 to 3,204; net change +644.
Legacy SB-ASI-P0001..SB-ASI-P2560 identities preserved without deletion or rename.
All 80 container names preserved across source versions.
Source-version count divergence recorded instead of silently merged.
40 filters, 12 states, 7 evidence levels, 20 failure classes and 30 operating-chain steps excluded from the parameter count.
Generation, relinking and R-F-R integrated into repository CI.
explicit_findings: CON-042 Core Reasoning is 48 parameters in the legacy 2,560 source and 42 named parameters in Human Functional Registry v1.0. The successor source does not delete the six legacy rows; atomic reconciliation remains open.
unresolved: Atomic legacy SB-ASI-P to successor SB-HFR-P identity reconciliation.
Runtime-owner classification of all 3,204 Human-derived parameters.
Final completeness of the HUMAN_PHYSICAL ontology, including body, appearance, ageing, longevity/life-extension and physical capacity.
